run_cli_with_config: run the fairchem CLI with a YAML config file using the -c flag
run_cli_on_slurm: run the fairchem CLI to launch a job on a SLURM cluster from a config
run_cli_locally: run the fairchem CLI in local mode with torch elastic or Ray from a config
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and canonicalize a Hydra YAML config with override arguments into a DictConfig
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
